fusions.name: Latching Bite
fusions.desc: A bite for 5 damage that leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds, with a 20% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 1 second.

fusions.name: Run to Ground
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health: deals 24 damage, up to 1.5 times that at 7 tiles, and leaves it [Inescapable] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Kennel Call
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 6 seconds. A pack of hounds fights beside you for 8 seconds, striking for 3 every 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Gatehound
fusions.desc: Calls a bonded hound that fights beside you. Every 1.2 seconds it bites an enemy within 4.5 tiles and deals 4 damage, and anything it bites moves 30% slower for 2 seconds.
